cameraConfiguration.scope: Final bath-only source on published R16.2, actual current main default/near camera outputs. Same female-slender braided-tail actor temporarily displays the existing low-bun. Production Three/Mesa scene and character; DOM labels/halo state are covered separately by the passing main controller test, not drawn by this scene renderer. Both views use the exact playerAppearance output for the same saved fixture identity used by the passing main lifecycle, with the onsen descriptor selecting temporary swimwear; pose time is fixed at1 in both views.
